keyEvents.text: Karim Coulibaly (Strasbourg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Cristian Cásseres (Toulouse).
Gessime Yassine (Strasbourg) is shown the yellow card.
Christ Tapé (Toulouse) is shown the yellow card.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Thomas Jørgensen (Toulouse) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Toulouse 1, Strasbourg 0. Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Sion Oppong.Goal awarded following VAR Review.
Goal! Toulouse 2, Strasbourg 0. Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Cristian Cásseres with a cross following a corner.
